message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests
on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run Playwright Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: latest
        package-manager-cache: false
    - name: Cache npm dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-npm-
    - name: Install xvfb
      run: sudo apt-get install xvfb
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    - name: Install Playwright Browsers
      run: npx playwright install --with-deps
    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: npm run test
    - name: Run e2e tests
      run: xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run test:e2e
    - name: Run Main Process tests
      run: npm run test:main
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      if: always()
      with:
        name: playwright-report
        path: playwright-report/
        retention-days: 30",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm ci` on every push/pull_request with `package-manager-cache: false`, so dependencies are re-fetched on every run. The repository has a `package-lock.json` lockfile, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE precondition that cache inputs include the lockfile. Adding an `actions/cache` step for `~/.npm` keyed on `package-lock.json` reuses dependency downloads across runs, matching the "Cache dependency downloads" pattern (reported modest VM-time savings) while preserving all test steps (Playwright, e2e, main process) and the artifact upload. No permissions are weakened and no new secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:

    - name: Cache npm dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-npm-
    - name: Install xvfb
      run: sudo apt-get install xvfb
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    - name: Install Playwright Browsers
      run: npx playwright install --with-deps
    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: npm run test
    - name: Run e2e tests
      run: xvfb-run --auto-servernum npm run test:e2e
    - name: Run Main Process tests
      run: npm run test:main
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      if: always()
      with:
        name: playwright-report
        path: playwright-report/
        retention-days: 30
